rationale: The previous iteration showed improved progress and slightly reduced RMS error but still failed to complete the tracks, with 2 line loss events per trial and notable steering oscillations (up to 0.224 on the s-bend). The increased kp and kd likely improved responsiveness and damping, while the moderate ki helped steady-state error correction. To further reduce steering oscillations and line loss events, I increased kd from 0.06 to 0.07 to enhance damping, reduced ki from 0.12 to 0.10 to avoid integral windup that might cause oscillations, and lowered base_speed from 0.14 to 0.13 to improve stability on curves without sacrificing much progress. Geometry and sensor layout remain unchanged as they are balanced and appropriate. I expect these changes to reduce steering oscillations and line loss events, improving completion likelihood and overall stability. The requested measurements will confirm improvements in completion, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation.
